name: core-templates
title: Core Templates
description: Pick a Core template and open it in the editor. Every option is built exclusively from Core — templates, widgets, validation. Badges show build maturity: ✓ Ready renders fully; ◐ Partial/Shell renders some regions; ○ Not built yet is a stub in Core.

query.en: The user picked this Core template from the gallery: "{{template}}". The part after the em dash is only a build-maturity badge — ignore it for resolution. Follow the core-compose skill exactly: call the core MCP list_templates, find the template whose name matches the picked one, then generate_page_instance for its id and write index.html using the Core render wrapper. If Core reports the template has no widgets or empty required regions (the badge says 'Not built yet' or 'Shell only'), still generate what exists, but state plainly in your summary that this template is not fully built in Core yet and which regions are empty.
